title: Phase Diagram Explorer
description: Phase Diagram Explorer computes binary temperature-composition phase diagrams at 1 atm from assessed CALPHAD thermodynamic databases (Compound Energy Formalism with Redlich-Kister excess terms and the Inden-Hillert-Jarl magnetic model). Equilibria come from the convex hull of the phase Gibbs energies, refined to exact common tangents; phase boundaries are traced adaptively and invariant reactions are located by root-finding. Results for the validated systems Ag-Cu, Pb-Sn (NIST solder database) and Fe-C (metastable Fe-Fe3C and stable Fe-graphite) are checked against pycalphad on the same database files, against the database authors' published calculations, and, for Ag-Cu and Fe-C, against an experimental assessment and commonly quoted textbook values. The thermodynamic databases are not included; they are downloaded from their official sources and verified by SHA256.
